SELECT count(*) as total_rows 
FROM Staging_Sales where LastModifiedDate>'@{activity('Get_Gold_Watermark').output.firstRow.LastWatermarkValue}'

/* ============================
   DimCountry
   ============================ */

INSERT INTO DimCountry (CountryName)
SELECT DISTINCT s.Country
FROM Staging_Sales s
WHERE s.LastModifiedDate >
      '@{activity('Get_Gold_Watermark').output.firstRow.LastWatermarkValue}'
AND NOT EXISTS
(
    SELECT 1
    FROM DimCountry d
    WHERE d.CountryName = s.Country
);


/* ============================
   DimCustomer
   ============================ */

INSERT INTO DimCustomer (CustomerID)
SELECT DISTINCT s.CustomerID
FROM Staging_Sales s
WHERE s.LastModifiedDate >
      '@{activity('Get_Gold_Watermark').output.firstRow.LastWatermarkValue}'
AND NOT EXISTS
(
    SELECT 1
    FROM DimCustomer d
    WHERE d.CustomerID = s.CustomerID
);


/* ============================
   DimProduct
   ============================ */

INSERT INTO DimProduct
(
    StockCode,
    Description
)
SELECT
    s.StockCode,
    MIN(s.Description)
FROM Staging_Sales s
WHERE s.LastModifiedDate >
      '@{activity('Get_Gold_Watermark').output.firstRow.LastWatermarkValue}'
AND NOT EXISTS
(
    SELECT 1
    FROM DimProduct d
    WHERE d.StockCode = s.StockCode
)
GROUP BY s.StockCode;


/* ============================
   DimDate
   ============================ */

INSERT INTO DimDate
(
    DateKey,
    FullDate,
    Year,
    Quarter,
    Month,
    Day,
    DayOfWeek
)
SELECT DISTINCT

    CAST(
        FORMAT(CAST(s.InvoiceDate AS DATE), 'yyyyMMdd')
        AS INT
    ),

    CAST(s.InvoiceDate AS DATE),

    YEAR(s.InvoiceDate),

    DATEPART(QUARTER, s.InvoiceDate),

    MONTH(s.InvoiceDate),

    DAY(s.InvoiceDate),

    DATENAME(WEEKDAY, s.InvoiceDate)

FROM Staging_Sales s

WHERE s.LastModifiedDate >
      '@{activity('Get_Gold_Watermark').output.firstRow.LastWatermarkValue}'

AND NOT EXISTS
(
    SELECT 1
    FROM DimDate d
    WHERE d.DateKey =
        CAST(
            FORMAT(CAST(s.InvoiceDate AS DATE), 'yyyyMMdd')
            AS INT
        )
);

MERGE FactSales AS target

USING
(
    SELECT
        s.RecordID,
        s.Invoice,
        s.StockCode,
        s.CustomerID,

        CAST(
            FORMAT(CAST(s.InvoiceDate AS DATE), 'yyyyMMdd')
            AS INT
        ) AS DateKey,

        c.CountryKey,

        s.Quantity,
        s.Price,

        s.Quantity * s.Price AS TotalAmount,

        s.IsCancelled,
        s.RecordType,
        s.LastModifiedDate

    FROM Staging_Sales s

    INNER JOIN DimCountry c
        ON c.CountryName = s.Country

    WHERE s.LastModifiedDate >
          '@{activity('Get_Gold_Watermark').output.firstRow.LastWatermarkValue}'

) AS source

ON target.RecordID = source.RecordID


WHEN MATCHED THEN

UPDATE SET

    target.Invoice = source.Invoice,
    target.StockCode = source.StockCode,
    target.CustomerID = source.CustomerID,
    target.DateKey = source.DateKey,
    target.CountryKey = source.CountryKey,
    target.Quantity = source.Quantity,
    target.Price = source.Price,
    target.TotalAmount = source.TotalAmount,
    target.IsCancelled = source.IsCancelled,
    target.RecordType = source.RecordType,
    target.LastModifiedDate = source.LastModifiedDate


WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN

INSERT
(
    RecordID,
    Invoice,
    StockCode,
    CustomerID,
    DateKey,
    CountryKey,
    Quantity,
    Price,
    TotalAmount,
    IsCancelled,
    RecordType,
    LastModifiedDate
)

VALUES
(
    source.RecordID,
    source.Invoice,
    source.StockCode,
    source.CustomerID,
    source.DateKey,
    source.CountryKey,
    source.Quantity,
    source.Price,
    source.TotalAmount,
    source.IsCancelled,
    source.RecordType,
    source.LastModifiedDate
);

SELECT MAX(LastModifiedDate) AS NewWatermark
FROM FactSales;

UPDATE WatermarkControl
SET LastWatermarkValue =
    CONVERT(
        DATETIME,
        LEFT(
            REPLACE(
                '@{activity('Get_New_Watermark').output.resultSets[0].rows[0].NewWatermark}',
                'Z',
                ''
            ),
            23
        ),
        126
    )
WHERE TableName = 'FactSales';
